info.title: Stable Baseline
info.description: Stable Baseline is an agent-managed company brain. People and AI agents co-author living documents, generate 40-plus kinds of diagrams and infographics, design freeform whiteboards, manage plans and tasks, and search a shared, self-updating knowledge graph from one secure workspace.

post.summary: Invoke the Stable Baseline MCP server
post.description: Streamable HTTP entry point that exposes every Stable Baseline tool to agents. Tools are discovered dynamically from the live server, so new and updated tools appear automatically.
